known.summary: the durable-solutions policy step leaves out plan-contract.md, docs/PLAN.md, and its byte mirror plan-md-template.md, so the canonical record standard lacks the explicit-user-request exception the Goal requires (and no phase test pins the shared clause)

the migration claim says no lifecycle command re-reads a finished plan's verdicts after archive, but showPlan always calls reviewSummary and archivePlan reads the code verdict, so the behavior of old em-dash records under the hyphen-only grammar is unstated and has no finished-plan show/archive fixtures
the em-dash refusal is added only to checkPlan, but `new --goal` builds and publishes a body without that check, so a new plan can still be created with an em dash

docs/PLAN-QUEUE.md still writes the empty Depends sentinel as U+2014, and step 1 makes parseQueue accept only '-', so `next` reads the old sentinel as a dependency; the queue file is not in the cutover
`status ... blocked --reason` validates only the old body and then writes the supplied reason unchecked, so a reason containing U+2014 defeats the body-wide refusal
